name: respira-wordpress
description: Edit WordPress sites with Claude in the site's own page builder: Elementor, Divi, Bricks, Gutenberg and more. Page and post edits are saved as a snapshot first and can be restored, and by default edits to a published page land on a draft you approve.

site_url.title: WordPress site address
site_url.description: The address of the WordPress site that has the Respira plugin, for example https://example.com. No slash at the end.

site_key.title: Respira site key
site_key.description: In WordPress admin open Respira, then Settings, then API Keys, and add a new key. It is stored in your system's credential store, not in a file.

mcp_path.title: Respira address on the site
mcp_path.description: Leave as it is for every Respira tool. For the short Focus list of tools, use wp-json/respira/v1/mcp/focus.
